test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Oscar is the most prestigious award which is __introduced to good__ actors in that year.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires a phrase that accurately describes the Oscars being given to top actors for their performances.
 
• "**Awarded to the best" correctly captures the idea that the Oscars are given to the best actors.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: rewarded to good** – Inappropriate because **"rewarded" is not the proper verb and "good" lacks the right connotation.**
 
• **Option 2: nominated to fine** – Inappropriate because** it talks about nominations and "fine" does not fit well.**
 
• **Option 4: attached to fine** – Inappropriate because **it does not make sense in this context.**
